IncidentDef.Name: ExSymbiotes_SymbioteMassBase
IncidentDef.letterText:
A mysterious symbiote mass has crashed nearby.

The symbiote mass pulsates with putrid psychic energy, gradually intensifying as it approaches some dangerous limit. You can send colonists to suppress the symbiote mass to prevent it from waking up.

You can also mark the symbiote mass for study to try to learn its purpose and perhaps make use of it.

You can always attack the symbiote mass to destroy it, but doing so may unleash unnatural and dangerous phenomena.
